description: Read one project file, e.g. 'story.md', or (the Script Coordinator only) one of the showrunner's files, by the name list_artifacts gives it (it starts with 'campaigns/').
_why: The way an agent reaches anything not already in its prompt. Only the Script Coordinator may open the showrunner's files under campaigns/; everyone else is pointed at characters.md, world.md and story.md, which it made from them.
